name: World Wrestling Federation Championship
epitaph: The diary's World Wrestling Federation Championship: its own title history in the diary's posts dates 8 reigns, from Diesel's (November 1994) to Steve Austin's (March 1998). The last post, in March 1998 on the diary's calendar, leaves Steve Austin as champion.

name: World Wrestling Federation Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: The diary's World Wrestling Federation Intercontinental Championship: its own title history in the diary's posts dates 11 reigns, from Goldust's (February 1996) to Dean Malenko's (March 1998). Before them the list names Razor Ramon's reign, his fourth by its count, without a date; the diary's first shows have him as champion until Goldust wins the belt in February 1996. The last post, in March 1998 on the diary's calendar, leaves Dean Malenko as champion.

name: World Wrestling Federation European Championship
epitaph: The diary's World Wrestling Federation European Championship: its own title history in the diary's posts dates 7 reigns, from The British Bulldog's (March 1997) to Booker T's (February 1998). The last post, in March 1998 on the diary's calendar, leaves Booker T as champion.

name: World Wrestling Federation Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The diary's World Wrestling Federation Light Heavyweight Championship: its own title history in the diary's posts dates 8 reigns, from Scorpio's (January 1996) to Chris Jericho's (August 1997); created in January 1996 and retired at SummerSlam in August 1997 (the diary's own list ends it "Championship Retired").

name: World Wrestling Federation Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The diary's World Wrestling Federation Tag Team Championship: its own title history in the diary's posts dates 13 reigns, from Owen Hart & The British Bulldog's (January 1996) to Al Snow & Chris Candido's (March 1998). Before them the list names The Smoking Gunn's reign, their second by its count, without a date; they lose the belts at the Royal Rumble of January 1996. The last post, in March 1998 on the diary's calendar, leaves Al Snow & Chris Candido as champion.
